script.title: NO HOT WATER TONIGHT
script.scene_zh: 飯店櫃台 · 沒有熱水
script.story_hook: One cold shower sends Dana to the front desk.
script.intro_zh: 一場冷水澡，讓達納深夜走到櫃台。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to tonight's hotel lobby. Something's wrong with the water.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今晚的飯店大廳，水好像出了點問題。
script.outro: Hot water found, night saved. Polite words open more doors. Good night!
script.outro_zh: 熱水找到了，夜晚得救了。禮貌的英語最好用。晚安！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat the whole desk chat.
script.practice_intro_zh: 輪到我們把整段櫃台對話跟讀一次。
script.char_a_description: a tired man in his early thirties, sandy short hair tucked under a gray beanie, wire-frame glasses, olive zip hoodie over a plain tee, canvas weekender bag on one shoulder, lean build, sleepless face
script.char_b_description: a friendly woman in her late twenties, dark brown hair in a neat braided crown, gold stud earrings, burgundy hotel vest over a white shirt with a name tag, slim build, calm apologetic smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑðɚ ju æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思打擾你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No bother at all, sir. What happened?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbɑðɚ ət ˈɔl sɜɹ wʌt həˈpænd/
dialogue.zh: 不會的，先生，怎麼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's no hot water in my room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz noʊ hɑt ˈwɔɾɚ ɪn maɪ ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 我的房間沒有熱水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Which room are you in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ noʊ wɪtʃ ɹum ɑɹ ju ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，天啊，您住在哪間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two one four, on the second floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wʌn fɔɹ ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 二一四號房，在二樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shower, or the sink too?
dialogue.zh: 是淋浴，還是臉盆也沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sink too. Cold only, both handles.
dialogue.zh: 臉盆也是，兩個旋鈕都只有冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, that's rough this hour.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，這個時間真的難受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, I've got work in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ aɪv ɡət wɜɹk ɪn ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我早上還要上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did it stop suddenly, or all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt stɑp ˈsʌdənli ɔɹ ˌɔl ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是突然停的，還是整天都沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight. My shower went cold mid-suds.
dialogue.zh: 就是今晚，我洗到一半水就變冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, mid-suds? I feel for you.
dialogue.zh: 天，洗到一半？我都能同理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And now I'm here, in a bath towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd naʊ aɪm hɪɹ ɪn ə bæθ ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 而我現在就裹著浴巾站在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me check the boiler status.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ˈbɔɪlɚ ˈsteɪtəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我查一下鍋爐的狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. Um, is this happening often?
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。呃，這種事常發生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely. Twice since I started here.
dialogue.zh: 很少，我來這兒只遇過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, lucky me, the third time.
dialogue.zh: 那我還真幸運，正好第三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maintenance says the pilot light went out.
dialogue.phonetic: /məɪnˈtɛnəns sɛz ðə ˈpaɪlət laɪt wɛnt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 工程那邊說，是爐火熄掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they just relight it tonight?
dialogue.zh: 他們今晚可以先把它點燃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're on it. It'll take an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ɑn ɪt ɪtəl teɪk ən ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 他們已經在處理，但要一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour? I smell like a gym bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈaʊɚ aɪ smɛl laɪk ə dʒɪm bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一小時？我渾身像個運動背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then here's a thought. Room switch?
dialogue.zh: 那我提個方案，換間房怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that really work tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚真的還換得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. A 408 is free right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə fɔɹ oʊ eɪt ɪz fri ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，四零八現在剛好空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it the same view as my old one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ðə seɪm vju æz maɪ oʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 窗景跟我原來那間一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better. It faces the courtyard.
dialogue.zh: 還更好，它面向中庭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Can someone carry my bags?
dialogue.zh: 就這樣辦，可以幫我把行李拿過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Raj will grab them.
dialogue.zh: 當然，拉吉會幫您拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Um, what about my key card?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ʌm wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ ki kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。呃，我的門卡怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll make a new one right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl meɪk ə nu wʌn ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就做一張新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're great. Honestly, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 你真好，真的謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's our job, a messy one today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑɹ dʒɑb ə ˈmɛsi wʌn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的工作，只是今天有點亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, if that's okay.
dialogue.zh: 再問一個問題，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask away.
dialogue.zh: 當然，你問吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will breakfast still be at seven?
dialogue.zh: 早餐還是七點開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, same time, same place.
dialogue.zh: 對，時間地點都不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. My laptop's still in 214.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑps stɪl ɪn tu wʌn fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的筆電還放在二一四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll fetch it, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 我們幫你拿過來，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the wifi code? It was taped up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ koʊd ɪt wəz teɪpt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 還有網路密碼，之前用貼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's taped inside the new room's drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts teɪpt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə nu ɹums ˈdɹɔɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 貼在新的那間房，抽屜裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Oh, before I forget...
dialogue.zh: 很好。噢，趁我還沒忘記……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sir?
dialogue.zh: 先生，您說？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the heat work in the new room?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə hit wɜɹk ɪn ðə nu ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 新房間的暖氣還可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Radiators are on a different loop.
dialogue.zh: 暖氣走的是獨立的管線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, warm or cold there too?
dialogue.zh: 所以那間是暖還是冷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs separately, so yes, warm.
dialogue.zh: 它是獨立系統，所以是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just upgraded my whole night.
dialogue.zh: 多虧你，我今晚還有救。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's kind of you, sir.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，你太客氣了，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, Dana is fine.
dialogue.zh: 叫我達納就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dana it is. Here's your new key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdænə ɪt ɪz hɪɹz jɔɹ nu kiː/
dialogue.zh: 好，達納，這是你的新房卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. And if 214 gets water back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd ɪf tu wʌn fɔɹ ɡɛts ˈwɔɾɚ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那如果二一四恢復熱水了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: 408 is yours for tonight, stay put.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ oʊ eɪt ɪz jɔɹz fɚ təˈnaɪt steɪ pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚四零八就是您的，安心住下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, my shower timer is a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔːlsoʊ maɪ ˈʃaʊɚ ˈtaɪməɹ ɪz ə θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，我洗澡都會計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do you mean, a timer?
dialogue.zh: 計時？你洗澡還用定時器？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, hot water, then nothing.
dialogue.zh: 熱水十二分鐘，之後就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not in 408, friend. Strong pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪn fɔɹ oʊ eɪt frɛnd stɹɔŋ ˈpɹɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 四零八不會這樣，水壓很強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now that is news I like.
dialogue.zh: 這才是我愛聽的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy the hot water. Text if anything fails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə hɑt ˈwɔɾɚ tɛkst ɪf ˈɛniθɪŋ feɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 好好享受熱水，有事傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've turned a disaster into five stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz tɜrnd ə dɪˈzæstɚ ˈɪntu faɪv stɑɹz/
dialogue.zh: 你讓我今晚從災難變成五星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five stars? I'll tell my manager.
dialogue.zh: 五星？我要跟經理說一聲。

script.youtube_title_en: My Shower Went Cold - Reporting No Hot Water at a Hotel Desk
script.youtube_description:
「My shower went cold!」半夜走進飯店大廳，如何用英文禮貌地反映問題？這一集 60 句完整對話：從沒有熱水、查鍋爐、換房間，到早餐時間與暖氣確認，全部在同一個櫃台場景裡自然發生。

你會聽到：
- 說明故障（There's no hot water in my room.）
- 聽懂維修說明（The pilot light went out.）
- 換房與搬行李（Room switch? / Sold. Can someone carry my bags?）
- 收尾客套（Text if anything fails.）

沒有生氣的客戶，只有清楚又禮貌的英文。多聽幾遍，你也可以這樣說。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再開口，不用背，多聽就會用。

適合常出差、自助旅行，或想在國外處理突發狀況的 A2 初級學習者。

喜歡就訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺，每週一個新場景。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
"My shower went cold!" - one continuous 60-line scene at a hotel front desk after midnight. No hot water, a boiler with a pilot light out, a room switch, a fresh key card, and a guest who leaves smiling.

You will hear real phrases like: "There's no hot water in my room.", "Can they just relight it tonight?", "Room switch?", "Text if anything fails."

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so the phrases stick without memorizing.

Made for A2 learners who want to handle travel mishaps abroad in English.

If you like immersive scenario-based listening, subscribe and hit the bell for a new scene every week.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
洗澡洗到一半，水突然變冰的，你會怎麼跟櫃台開口？
聽得出 pilot light、maintenance、room switch 嗎？
這一集帶大家走進深夜的飯店櫃台：客人達納裹著浴巾來反映，櫃員一步一步幫他換到熱水超强的房間。

你會聽到：
- 🚿 說明狀況：There's no hot water in my room.
- 🔧 聽懂原因：Maintenance says the pilot light went out.
- 🔑 換房處理：Room switch? / Here's your new key.
- 🛏️ 貼心收尾：Enjoy the hot water. Text if anything fails.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽一遍，再大聲跟讀每一句，讓句子自然留在嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你下次在飯店遇到小麻煩，想到的第一句英文就是：Sorry to bother you.
script.thumbnail_expression: unamused, eyebrows raised, holding a towel
script.thumbnail_action: wrapping a bath towel tighter while pointing back toward the stairs
